title: Matt Peterson on His Investment Approach and Proprietary AI Research Platform
summary: Matt's investment approach combines a value-oriented, research-intensive process with sophisticated options strategies to generate superior risk-adjusted returns. Peterson Investment Fund I was established in 2011 as a capital allocation vehicle with a mission to build enormous wealth for long-term partners. Matthew worked as a member of both the US and UK offices, with expertise spanning risk management and derivative processing.
